newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan oil basket down $0.54 to $20.70.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan oil basket down $0.54 to $20.70.

text.p: The average export price for Venezuela's basket of crude and oil products dropped $0.54 to $20.70 per barrel in the week to Friday, its second consecutive weekly drop, the Energy and Mines Ministry said.
Venezuela's average oil export price since the beginnning of the year is $21.74 per barrel. In 1996 it was $18.25 per barrel, sharply up from $14.84 in 1995 and $13.23 in 1994.
The government has based 1997 budget calculations on an average price of $14.00 per barrel.
